title: Brainstorm: YuE2 song model (Flow, audio workspace, DAW widgets)
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-1179 - New Models to Test. Menu: tasks/MPI-1179/plan.md. Moved here from umbrella MPI-986 (Mix and audio), Fabio 2026-10-18. Its DAW widgets still reuse MPI-917's Mix components.

Brainstorm card, no plan yet: how to bring YuE2 (open-source song model with an editable score) into the app. Ideas to explore: a Flow, a first audio workspace, DAW widgets such as a piano roll and a track selector. Links, model facts and the licence decision are in brief.md.
